welcome.title: Everyday taps
welcome.text: Windows will appear in front of you. Do what each one asks, as you would on a real one: they don't move or click, the cameras record your hands.|Press the button on the right side of the headset to start each step. Pressed while recording, it pauses.

done.title: All done
done.text: Thank you! This recording session will close. Continue in the application.|Review your recordings in the Hand recorder window.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.text: What was recorded so far is saved. Review it in the Hand recorder window.

sections.title: Hand size
sections.intro: First, your hand size: both hands up about 40 cm out, still.

prompts.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Palms toward you

switch.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Backs toward you

sections.title: Everyday taps
sections.intro: Taps at the distance you normally hold your hands, about 40 cm out: pointing, with your palm toward you, and with the hand low by your lap. Nothing happens when you tap: the cameras record your hand.

prompts.text: Right hand up in front of your chest, palm away, elbow bent, about 40 cm from your eyes.|Point it at each lit button. Cyan: tap thumb to index. Purple: thumb to middle fingertip.
Left hand up in front of your chest, palm away, elbow bent, about 40 cm from your eyes.|Point it at each lit button. Cyan: tap thumb to index. Purple: thumb to middle fingertip.

Turn your right hand palm toward you, fingers up, about 40 cm out: you see your palm, not the back of the hand.|Keep it there and tap when a button lights. Cyan: thumb to index. Purple: thumb to middle.
Left hand now, palm toward you, fingers up, about 40 cm out.|Cyan: thumb to index. Purple: thumb to middle.
Right hand low by your lap, palm down and relaxed. Look at the lit button and tap where the hand is.|Cyan: thumb to index. Purple: thumb to middle.
Left hand low by your lap, palm down and relaxed. Look at the lit button and tap where the hand is.|Cyan: thumb to index. Purple: thumb to middle.

Right hand up and pointing again. Where a button says hold, keep the fingertips together for about a second,|as when you drag: cyan with the index, purple with the middle finger. The others are plain taps.
Left hand pointing. Hold: fingertips together for about a second, cyan with the index,|purple with the middle finger. The others are plain taps.
Right hand, palm toward you again. Cyan: tap thumb to index. Purple: thumb to middle.|Orange with a cross: bring thumb and index about 1 cm apart and stop there, without touching.
Left hand, palm toward you. Cyan: tap. Purple: middle tap.|Orange with a cross: stop about 1 cm short, without touching.
Both hands up, about 40 cm out, however feels comfortable. Each lit button says L or R:|tap with that hand, cyan thumb to index, purple thumb to middle.
Your own pace: tap as you do every day, index and middle, as often as you like.|Turn the hand as you go: palm away, on its side, palm toward you, low by your lap.

says.tap: Your own pace: tap thumb to index as often as you like
says.middle: Your own pace: tap thumb to middle as often as you like

sections.title: Every fingertip
sections.intro: Last: your thumb on every fingertip, with no window. Open your hand between touches.

prompts.text: Hand up about 40 cm out, palm toward you. Touch your thumb to each fingertip in turn:|index, middle, ring, little, and back. Open the hand wide between touches.
Only the ring and little fingers now: thumb to ring, thumb to little, about a second each,|while you slowly turn the hand: palm toward you, on its side, back toward you.
